name: Signalwave
summary: Unlike other Vaporwave subgenres that often rework samples into new musical compositions, Signalwave frequently presents its source material in a more fragmented and raw state.
description: Unlike other Vaporwave subgenres that often rework samples into new musical compositions, Signalwave frequently presents its source material in a more fragmented and raw state. The result is a soundscape that prioritizes atmosphere and texture over melody, evoking the feeling of stumbling upon a piece of lost media from a bygone era. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Nostalgia, memory, liminality, media decay, mystery
